ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious Eventlog Clearing or Configuration Change Activity
ruleDefinitions.description:
Detects the clearing or configuration tampering of EventLog using utilities such as "wevtutil", "powershell" and "wmic".
This technique were seen used by threat actors and ransomware strains in order to evade defenses.

sequences.query: (((process_path = RGX("\\\\wevtutil\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "wevtutil\.exe") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*clear\\-log\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ cl\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*set\\-log\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ sl\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*lfn\\:.*")))) OR (((process_path = RGX("\\\\powershell\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\powershell\\_ise\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\pwsh\\\.exe$")) AND ((process_command_line = RGX(".*Clear\\-EventLog\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*Remove\\-EventLog\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*Limit\\-EventLog\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*Clear\\-WinEvent\\ .*")) OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*Eventing\\\.Reader\\\.EventLogSession.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*ClearLog.*")) OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*Diagnostics\\\.EventLog.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*Clear.*"))))) OR (((process_path = RGX("\\\\powershell\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\powershell\\_ise\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\pwsh\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\wmic\\\.exe$")) AND process_command_line = RGX(".*ClearEventLog.*"))) AND  NOT (((parent_process_path = "C\:\\Windows\\SysWOW64\\msiexec\.exe" OR parent_process_path = "C\:\\Windows\\System32\\msiexec\.exe") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ sl\\ .*")))
